opportunities.name: Paper research: arXiv search, Semantic Scholar lookup, note
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic in a specific year, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, then save a summary note.
steps: Tick the date filter and choose specific year, enter the year
Click Search and open the top result
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the paper
Read the first author and citation count
Add a note: 'topic (year): title by author, N citations'
